title: OFTNet: Omni-Feature and Texture-Aware Enhancement Learning Network for Continuous Remote Sensing Image Super-Resolution

title: Structure-Aware Coarse-to-Fine Upsampling Network for Arbitrary-Scale Super-Resolution of Remote Sensing Images
what_is_continuous: The method learns a mapping from coordinate-domain latent codes to spatial-domain RGB values and is queried at arbitrary scaling factors.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The continuous coordinate decoder is used directly to reconstruct remote-sensing images at arbitrary scales; removing the coordinate-based arbitrary-scale mechanism would change the core method.
notes: Strong coordinate-domain evidence.

title: TADSR: Texture-Aware Dynamic Gaussian Splatting for Continuous-Scale Remote Sensing Image Super-Resolution
what_is_continuous: The underlying RSI is modeled as a spatially continuous signal represented with 2-D Gaussian primitives that can be evaluated for arbitrary target scales; Gaussian centers can move off the regular image grid.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The continuous Gaussian scene/image representation is the reconstruction mechanism for remote-sensing super-resolution and is specifically adapted to RSI texture heterogeneity and non-grid-aligned geographic boundaries.
notes: Strongest evidence in this batch: the paper explicitly contrasts discrete sampling with continuous Gaussian representations.

title: AnyTSR++: Prompt-Oriented Any-Scale Thermal Super-Resolution for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle
what_is_continuous: The requested spatial scaling factors can vary continuously, including asymmetric scaling along different directions; the upsampler uses coordinate-offset information rather than a fixed integer-scale head.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The method targets UAV thermal remote-sensing imagery and the any-scale coordinate-aware upsampler is central to generating thermal images at arbitrary requested resolutions.
notes: Classify as continuous-scale thermal RSI, not as a generic INR unless the final text explicitly uses that label.

title: Binary Lightweight Neural Networks for Arbitrary Scale Super-Resolution of Remote Sensing Images
what_is_continuous: A binary continuous up-sampling module enables the same lightweight model to generate remote-sensing SR outputs at arbitrary scale factors rather than only pre-defined fixed scales.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: Continuity is operationally required by the arbitrary-scale RSI SR objective and implemented by the continuous upsampling module; it is not merely an efficiency paper using a fixed-grid SR head.
notes: Retain, but describe continuity specifically as arbitrary-scale reconstruction.

title: Latent Diffusion, Implicit Amplification: Efficient Continuous-Scale Super-Resolution for Remote Sensing Images
what_is_continuous: The model supports non-integer and continuously varying magnification factors through a continuous-scale upsampling module in the reconstruction decoder.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The diffusion model is designed specifically for remote-sensing SR, and the continuous-scale reconstruction branch removes the fixed-integer-scale restriction of conventional diffusion SR.
notes: Continuity belongs to the reconstruction scale; diffusion itself is not the reason for inclusion.

title: A Continuous Digital Elevation Representation Model for DEM Super-Resolution
what_is_continuous: Terrain elevation is represented as a continuous function of geographic position, allowing height values to be queried at arbitrary positions instead of only at raster DEM grid cells.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: This is directly a remote-sensing/photogrammetric terrain representation problem: the learned continuous elevation field removes raster discretization limits and supports multi-scale DEM super-resolution.
notes: Canonical example of a true continuous geospatial field, stronger than merely continuous-scale SR.

title: MWLN: Multilevel Wavelet Learning Network for Continuous-Scale Remote-Sensing Image Super-Resolution
what_is_continuous: The requested magnification factor is continuous/arbitrary rather than restricted to a fixed set of integer scales; one network is trained for continuous-scale RSI SR.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The method is formulated around continuous-scale reconstruction of remote-sensing images, so the continuous scale is a core task variable rather than an auxiliary augmentation.
notes: Full-text mechanism should still be captured later for a stronger representation-level description.

title: Continuous Remote Sensing Image Super-Resolution Based on Context Interaction in Implicit Function Space
what_is_continuous: The model constructs pixel-wise implicit functions and evaluates a parser at requested coordinates, mapping coordinates and attributes to RGB values across continuous magnifications.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The implicit coordinate-to-radiance/intensity mapping is the actual remote-sensing SR decoder; arbitrary magnification is achieved by querying this function rather than selecting a fixed upsampling head.
notes: Strong INR evidence.

title: Learning Dynamic Scale Awareness and Global Implicit Functions for Continuous-Scale Super-Resolution of Remote Sensing Images
what_is_continuous: The continuous-scale upsampling module builds multi-resolution feature spaces that approximate a continuous image representation, and the global implicit function maps arbitrary coordinates to pixel values.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The coordinate-queryable implicit function is the core mechanism for continuous-scale remote-sensing image reconstruction and is coupled to scale-aware feature extraction tailored to RSI textures.
notes: Strong coordinate-based continuity evidence.

title: Lightweight Stepless Super-Resolution of Remote Sensing Images via Saliency-Aware Dynamic Routing Strategy
what_is_continuous: The stepless upsampling module uses an implicit feature function to map low-resolution features to high-resolution outputs at arbitrary potential scale factors.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The remote-sensing SR method explicitly removes fixed integer-scale constraints; the implicit upsampling function is essential to the stepless reconstruction objective, while dynamic routing addresses efficiency.
notes: Continuity is supplied by the implicit upsampling module, not by the saliency-aware routing.

title: Hierarchical Feature Aggregation and Self-Learning Network for Remote Sensing Image Continuous-Scale Super-Resolution
what_is_continuous: A single model supports arbitrary integer and non-integer scale factors; its self-learning upscaling structure dynamically predicts upsampling filters rather than using one fixed-scale reconstruction head.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The arbitrary-scale variable is intrinsic to the RSI SR task, and the learned upscaling mechanism is specifically designed to realize continuous-scale remote-sensing reconstruction.
notes: Continuous-scale by dynamic upsampling, not necessarily an INR.

title: A Unified Network for Arbitrary Scale Super-Resolution of Video Satellite Images
what_is_continuous: The zoom/magnification factor is allowed to vary arbitrarily instead of being restricted to several integer scales, with one unified model serving the scale continuum.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The method directly targets video satellite imagery and makes arbitrary-scale spatial reconstruction a central capability; the paper would revert to a conventional fixed-scale satellite SR method if this mechanism were removed.
notes: Early continuous-scale satellite-video work; distinguish arbitrary-scale output from continuous temporal modeling.

title: A continuous implicit neural representation framework with gradient regularization for sea surface height reconstruction from satellite altimetry
what_is_continuous: SSH is explicitly represented as a continuous differentiable function of space and time learned from sparse along-track altimetry samples.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The continuous space-time field is the reconstruction target for satellite altimetry gaps and supports arbitrary-coordinate querying and spatial derivatives; removing the INR would remove the central reconstruction mechanism.
notes: Canonical CRS example: direct continuous Earth-observation field reconstruction.

title: A Generalized Eikonal Solver Using Operator Learning

what_is_continuous: The learned object is an operator that maps velocity/background-traveltime functions and source configurations to a traveltime field, generalizing to unseen velocity models and source locations.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: Traveltime is a geophysical field used in seismic migration/tomography, and function-to-function generalization is the method's central mechanism rather than an incidental network choice.
notes: Operator-learning inclusion; not merely because FNO/DeepONet names appear.

title: Adaptive SIREN-PINN With Principled Initialization: A Frequency-Aware and Singularity-Robust Framework for Solver-Free Acoustic Seismic Wave Modeling

title: EFKAN: A KAN-Integrated Neural Operator for Efficient Magnetotelluric Forward Modeling

title: Enhancing Frequency Response in Implicit Full Waveform Inversion via Fourier Encoding
what_is_continuous: The subsurface model is reparameterized by a coordinate-based implicit neural function; Fourier encoding changes the spectral basis used by that continuous representation.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The continuous subsurface parameterization is the inversion variable in seismic FWI and the paper's contribution explicitly modifies how that INR represents spatial frequencies.

title: Implicit full waveform inversion with adaptive Fourier frequency bases learning
what_is_continuous: The method explicitly uses coordinate-based INRs in which a spatial coordinate is mapped to the corresponding velocity; adaptive Fourier bases alter the frequency content learned by this continuous model.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The coordinate-to-velocity function is the actual parameterization optimized by seismic FWI, so continuity is inseparable from the proposed inversion method.

title: Implicit Neural Representations for 3D Gravity Inversion
what_is_continuous: The network directly maps spatial coordinates to a continuous subsurface density field rather than assigning independent voxel parameters.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: Gravity inversion is a geophysical sensing inverse problem and the continuous density field is the recovered physical object constrained by measured gravity anomalies.
notes: Canonical coordinate-to-physical-field case.

title: Least-squares-embedded optimization for accelerated convergence of PINNs in high-frequency acoustic wavefield simulations
what_is_continuous: The PINN maps coordinates (x,z) to the real and imaginary components of the scattered Helmholtz wavefield, with derivatives taken with respect to those continuous coordinates.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The learned continuous wavefield is the seismic forward solution itself; the paper improves optimization of this coordinate field rather than merely processing a discretized seismic image.
notes: Retained because full text explicitly defines coordinate-to-wavefield mapping.

title: M-SSIM-3DIFWI: 3-D Implicit Full Waveform Inversion Based on the Multiscale Structural Similarity
what_is_continuous: The 3-D velocity model is reparameterized with an INR, yielding a compact continuous representation of subsurface velocity rather than independently optimized grid cells.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The continuous subsurface velocity representation is one of the core components of the proposed 3-D seismic FWI and is explicitly used for implicit regularization and continuity/smoothness.

title: Microseismic monitoring with the quake neural operator
continuity_variable: continuous waveform function over time and station coordinates -> detection/location functions
what_is_continuous: QNO formulates the input as a waveform function f(t;x,y,z), works directly on continuous seismic streams, accommodates arbitrary network geometries, and learns spatial probability/location mappings.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The operator acts on geophysical waveform functions sampled by irregular seismic networks; geometry flexibility and function-level mapping are central to end-to-end microseismic monitoring.

title: Rapid 2-D Magnetotelluric Forward Modeling via Automatic Differentiation Fourier Neural Operator With Gradient Supervision
continuity_variable: grid position + frequency conditioned on resistivity field -> EM response
what_is_continuous: The trained forward model can predict electromagnetic fields at arbitrary grid positions and frequencies while learning the resistivity-to-response relationship.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: Arbitrary spatial/frequency evaluation is directly tied to MT sensing geometry and makes the method a queryable geophysical field operator rather than a fixed output regressor.
notes: Strong arbitrary-query evidence.

title: Reversible Deep Operator Network for Grid-Independent, Multi-Scale Magnetotelluric Inversion and Uncertainty Quantification
continuity_variable: station position + frequency + survey scale; resistivity/response functions
what_is_continuous: RDON learns forward/inverse mappings between subsurface resistivity distributions and MT responses, explicitly supporting arbitrarily sparse observations, unseen station layouts, frequency ranges, and survey scales.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: Grid independence and cross-scale generalization are explicit methodological goals for real MT observations, making this a strong continuous/operator remote-sensing case.

title: Spatiotemporal Implicit Neural Representation for Ionospheric Tomography With Multi-LEO Occultation Data

title: Three-dimensional inversion of gravity data using implicit neural representations and scientific machine learning

why_continuous_remote_sensing: The continuous field is the recovered geophysical quantity constrained by observed gravity data, so the INR is the inversion parameterization itself.
notes: Canonical mesh-free continuous inversion example.

why_continuous_remote_sensing: The representation is used to infer geophysical subsurface properties and uncertainty directly from seismic data; coordinate conditioning is fundamental to the Bayesian inversion parameterization.

title: Full-Waveform Inversion With Velocity Model Low-Rank Implicit Neural Representation
what_is_continuous: The velocity model is continuously parameterized by coordinate-based neural branches and a low-rank core, mapping coordinates to velocity values while encoding low-rank structure and smoothness.

notes: Strong continuous multiparameter inversion case.

title: Implicit neural representation for potential field geophysics
what_is_continuous: The method learns a potential-field function from scattered survey samples and can query values and analytical gradients at arbitrary coordinates in the learned continuous spatial domain.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: It directly reconstructs airborne/geophysical survey fields from irregular samples and preserves continuous-domain differentiation, exactly matching the CRS field-representation criterion.
notes: Canonical scattered-sample-to-continuous-field case.

continuity_variable: seismic waveform/field input across acquisition geometry -> source location
what_is_continuous: The paper explicitly aims for a resolution-invariant operator model for source localization that generalizes across seismic sampling resolution without retraining.

representation_family: pretrained wavefield neural operator + physics-informed inversion
what_is_continuous: A pretrained neural operator replaces repeated wave-equation solves by mapping a velocity model field (with source/frequency conditions) to wavefield solutions used inside FWI.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The field-to-field operator is the computational core enabling differentiable geophysical inversion; the proposed physics constraint explicitly acts on the predicted continuous physical wavefield.
notes: Operator is central to the inversion loop; not retained merely because FNO is mentioned.

title: 5-D Seismic Data Interpolation by Continuous Representation
what_is_continuous: ISR takes seismic data coordinates as input and outputs amplitudes, allowing the trained function to be queried at missing coordinates and at desired resolution across a 5-D domain.

notes: Canonical seismic coordinate representation.

title: Fully Convolutional Network-Enhanced DeepONet-Based Surrogate of Predicting the Travel-Time Fields
what_is_continuous: The model learns a solution operator for eikonal traveltime fields across varying velocity models/sources rather than a single fixed simulation instance.

title: Physics-Informed Robust and Implicit Full Waveform Inversion Without Prior and Low-Frequency Information

why_continuous_remote_sensing: The continuous subsurface parameterization is the defining difference from conventional FWI and is used to reduce dependence on an initial model and missing low frequencies.
notes: Unambiguous continuous-representation FWI.

title: PINN-Based Seismic Wavefield Simulation With Learnable Multiscale Fourier Feature Mapping and Adaptive Activation Function
what_is_continuous: The PINN represents the wavefield as a differentiable coordinate function and augments coordinate features to capture higher-frequency spatial components.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The coordinate neural field is the seismic PDE solution itself; the proposed changes target how that continuous wavefield is represented and optimized.

title: Seismic Traveltime Simulation for Variable Velocity Models Using Physics-Informed Fourier Neural Operator
what_is_continuous: PIFNO learns the operator from velocity and background traveltime fields to a perturbation traveltime field across variable models and multiple sources.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The function-to-function mapping solves an eikonal geophysical field problem and generalization across velocity models is central to the proposed seismic traveltime simulator.

title: Transfer Learning Fourier Neural Operator for Solving Parametric Frequency-Domain Wave Equations
what_is_continuous: The paper explicitly frames FNO as an infinite-dimensional functional mapping from parameter space to state-variable space and adapts that operator across source locations/frequencies.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The operator approximates geophysical frequency-domain wave-equation solution maps used in exploration, making function-space learning the core method.

title: Implicit Seismic Full Waveform Inversion With Deep Neural Representation
what_is_continuous: The method replaces grid-based subsurface parameters with a continuously and implicitly defined neural function of coordinates.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The continuous subsurface representation is directly optimized against seismic observations and is the defining mechanism of IFWI.
notes: Foundational CRS-style seismic inversion paper.

title: Multilayer Perceptron and Bayesian Neural Network-Based Elastic Implicit Full Waveform Inversion
what_is_continuous: The MLP or Bayesian neural network receives model-grid spatial positions and generates elastic property models (or their uncertainty distributions) used by the inversion.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: Coordinate-based implicit parameterization replaces direct cellwise inversion in elastic seismic FWI and is essential to the proposed uncertainty-aware method.

continuity_variable: velocity field + source location/frequency -> seismic wavefield

why_continuous_remote_sensing: The operator solves a geophysical wave-equation family across many subsurface models, sources, and frequencies rather than fitting one fixed-grid observation.

why_continuous_remote_sensing: This is a magnetotelluric/geophysical sensing forward operator with explicit continuous-query and discretization-transfer behavior.

why_continuous_remote_sensing: The Gaussian primitives are the scene/scattering representation optimized from SAR observations; 3DGS is not merely a renderer wrapped around a separate scene model.

title: ARSGaussian: 3D Gaussian Splatting with LiDAR for aerial remote sensing novel view synthesis
what_is_continuous: Aerial scene geometry/appearance is encoded by 3-D Gaussians whose locations, scales, depth, normals and radiance are constrained by LiDAR and multiview imagery.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The Gaussian field itself is the aerial remote-sensing scene representation used for novel-view synthesis and geometric recovery.

title: GaussianCraft: Fine-grained 3D Gaussians for efficient large-scene surface reconstruction
what_is_continuous: Large aerial scenes are represented by 3-D Gaussian fields initialized from multiview geometry and refined so Gaussian centers align with multiview-consistent physical surfaces.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The Gaussian field is directly optimized as the large-scale aerial surface representation and evaluated for geometric reconstruction, beyond novel-view rendering alone.

what_is_continuous: Gaussians are initialized on georeferenced LoD2 building surfaces and optimized with visual depth to represent urban geometry and appearance under sparse views.

title: SA-GS: Season-Aware Affine 3D Gaussian Splatting for Satellite Image Rendering

continuity_variable: 3-D scene position + satellite view -> orthorectified appearance

continuity_variable: 3-D position + SAR observation geometry -> scattering intensity

notes: Canonical spectral-spatial Gaussian field.

title: ULSR-GS: Urban Large-Scale Surface Reconstruction Gaussian Splatting with Multi-View Geometric Consistency
what_is_continuous: The urban scene is partitioned into Gaussian subfields and optimized with multiview-guided densification plus depth/normal consistency so primitives converge to a coherent surface.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The primary output is a high-resolution aerial-photogrammetric surface reconstruction and the Gaussian primitives are the optimized geometric representation.
notes: Strong geometric rather than rendering-only GS use.

title: Arbitrary-Scale Fusion Operator for High-Resolution Hyperspectral Imaging
continuity_variable: spatial scale; HSI/MSI treated as degraded spectral functions
what_is_continuous: AFO treats low-resolution hyperspectral and high-resolution multispectral observations as degraded functions and learns an operator that can reconstruct high-resolution HSI across arbitrary unseen scale factors.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The function/operator formulation is introduced specifically to remove one-model-per-scale hyperspectral fusion; cross-scale generalization is a central property, not an incidental architecture choice.
notes: Continuous variable is primarily spatial scale/function domain, not necessarily continuous wavelength querying.

title: Arbitrary-scale spatial-spectral fusion using kernel integral and progressive resampling
what_is_continuous: SFNO embeds two degraded image functions and approximates a mapping between function spaces through Galerkin kernel integration with progressive domain resampling, enabling unseen magnification factors.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The paper explicitly frames HSI/MSI fusion as function-space operator learning and tests arbitrary-scale remote-sensing fusion without retraining.
notes: Strong neural-operator case with explicit function-space mapping and scale transfer.

title: DCMArb: Decoupled-Collaborative Mamba for Arbitrary-scale Hyperspectral Super-resolution
what_is_continuous: Its SMUB reconstruction block combines INR with meta-learning to map spatial-spectral priors into a continuous scale-space function, including non-integer scale factors.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The continuous-scale function is the reconstruction mechanism for arbitrary-scale hyperspectral remote-sensing SR; removing it collapses the method to fixed-scale SR.
notes: Continuity is scale-space; spectral modeling is heterogeneous but not itself assumed smooth/continuous.

title: MGINR-WGAN: A Multiscale Guided Implicit Neural Representation Wasserstein GAN for Hyperspectral and Multispectral Image Fusion
what_is_continuous: The generator predicts the target HRHSI at a query coordinate from neighboring LRHSI features, relative coordinate offsets, and HRMSI guidance, thereby defining a continuous coordinate-conditioned fusion function.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The INR is a core HSI/MSI fusion encoder/decoder that reconstructs remote-sensing spectra at target spatial coordinates; continuity is explicit in both the theory and equations.
notes: Strong coordinate-level evidence.

title: NODiff: Neural Operator Diffusion for Multispectral Image Fusion
continuity_variable: none established beyond discretized feature maps
what_is_continuous: The audited paper replaces an attention denoiser with a neural operator mainly to reduce diffusion cost and learn texture priors; the abstract/paper evidence inspected does not establish arbitrary-coordinate querying, discretization transfer, or an explicit continuous field/function-space target.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: Pansharpening is a remote-sensing fusion task, but under the strict CRS gate a neural-operator layer used as an efficient denoising backbone is insufficient by itself.
notes: Remove unless stronger evidence demonstrates that function-space/discretization behavior is itself evaluated and central.

title: Solving Spatial-Spectral Fusion with Latent Spectral Operators
continuity_variable: spectral functions / frequency basis; spatial scale transfer
what_is_continuous: LSO learns fusion mappings between spectral functions using a structured trigonometric basis operator and demonstrates transfer across different spatial scales.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The method's central object is an operator between spectral functions for spatial-spectral image fusion, with explicit cross-scale transfer rather than a conventional fixed-grid fusion network.
notes: Strong spectral-function operator case; distinguish spectral-function representation from direct arbitrary-wavelength querying.

title: Spatial-Spectral Residuals Informed Diffusion Neural Operator for Pan-sharpening
what_is_continuous: The paper explicitly formulates diffusion in function space and uses a Galerkin-type neural operator as the denoising map while enforcing spatial-spectral residual consistency during reverse diffusion.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The function-space operator is the generative model for satellite pansharpening rather than an incidental layer, so the continuous/operator viewpoint is methodological.
notes: Retain; stronger evidence than NODiff because function-space diffusion is explicit.

title: A spatial-frequency dual-domain implicit guidance method for hyperspectral and multispectral remote sensing image fusion based on Kolmogorov–Arnold Network
what_is_continuous: SFIGNet performs guided implicit sampling in spatial and frequency domains and explicitly models HSI/MSI fusion in a continuous domain rather than with only discrete interpolation.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The continuous implicit sampling mechanism is central to hyperspectral/multispectral remote-sensing fusion and is used to overcome discrete sampling limitations.
notes: Continuity is primarily coordinate/feature sampling, not a claim that Fourier frequency itself is continuously queried.

title: Arbitrary-scale Fusion Neural Operator
what_is_continuous: AFNO treats LRHSI and HRMSI as functions, uses integration operators to preserve discretization invariance, and includes implicit neural functional integration plus continuous-discrete equivalence machinery.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The method is explicitly built to perform HSI/MSI fusion at arbitrary scales without retraining by learning a function-level fusion operator.
notes: Strong operator case: function treatment and discretization invariance are explicit.

title: Continuous Tensor Representation for Hyperspectral Anomaly Detection
what_is_continuous: CBAR models the HSI background with a continuous low-rank tensor function that maps coordinates to tensor values while jointly encoding low-rankness and smoothness.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The continuous tensor field is the actual background representation used to separate anomalies in hyperspectral remote-sensing data, not a generic continuous regularizer.
notes: Canonical continuous tensor/function case.

title: Mamba Collaborative Implicit Neural Representation for Hyperspectral and Multispectral Remote Sensing Image Fusion
continuity_variable: spatial query coordinates / continuous feature mapping
what_is_continuous: The method explicitly contrasts discrete data mapping with the continuous nature of the scene and uses implicit neural representation to perform coordinate-conditioned sampling/fusion, while Mamba supplies long-range context.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The INR branch is a core fusion mechanism for HSI/MSI remote-sensing imagery; Mamba alone is not the reason for inclusion.
notes: Retain for INR; do not describe ordinary Mamba sequence modeling as continuous.

title: Meta-Collaborative Learning for Arbitrarily Scaled Hyperspectral Image Super-Resolution
what_is_continuous: A single 3D meta-upsampling module and scale-aware adaptation mechanism handle arbitrary HSI SR factors rather than separate fixed-scale models.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The scale is a continuously variable reconstruction condition in a hyperspectral remote-sensing SR task and the meta-upsampler is the method's defining component.
notes: Continuous-scale rather than necessarily coordinate-field INR.

title: OTIAS: OcTree Implicit Adaptive Sampling for Multispectral and Hyperspectral Image Fusion
what_is_continuous: OTIAS extends coordinate-based implicit sampling from quadtree spatial interpolation to an octree that jointly samples horizontal and vertical/spectral directions, generating kernels from coordinates.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The coordinate-conditioned spatial-spectral sampler is the central HSI/MSI fusion mechanism and explicitly builds on INR's continuous image representation.
notes: Strong coordinate-sampling case across space and channel/spectral direction.

title: Physics-informed Neural Operator for Pansharpening
what_is_continuous: An iterative neural integral process learns a continuous radiance field L_i(x,y,lambda), then integrates it against sensor spectral responsivity to form the observed bands.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: This directly reconstructs the continuous physical radiance field underlying remote-sensing sensor measurements, making it a canonical Continuous Remote Sensing paper rather than merely an operator-branded pansharpening method.
notes: Very strong CRS case: continuity is explicit in x,y,lambda and tied to sensor physics.

title: An Implicit Transformer-based Fusion Method for Hyperspectral and Multispectral Remote Sensing Image
venue: Int. J. Applied Earth Observation and Geoinformation
continuity_variable: spatial and spectral point coordinates / feature positions
what_is_continuous: ITF-GAN uses point-to-point implicit functions and guided implicit sampling to replace discrete interpolation and model continuous nonlinear fusion relationships across spatial-spectral features.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The continuous implicit sampling is explicitly introduced to improve HSI/MSI remote-sensing fusion and is central to the method.
notes: Strong implicit-sampling evidence.

title: Arbitrary-Scale Hyperspectral Image Super-Resolution From a Fusion Perspective With Spatial Priors
what_is_continuous: SPG-ASSR incorporates a local implicit image function so the same HSI SR model can be queried for arbitrary scale factors while guided by spatial priors.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The implicit coordinate decoder is the key mechanism enabling arbitrary-scale hyperspectral remote-sensing reconstruction.
notes: Strong continuous-scale INR case.

title: Fourier-Enhanced Implicit Neural Fusion Network for Multispectral and Hyperspectral Image Fusion
what_is_continuous: FeINFN builds spatial- and frequency-domain implicit fusion functions plus an implicit decoder to represent/fuse HSI/MSI features beyond discrete local interpolation.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The INR functions are the proposed fusion mechanism for remote-sensing spectral imagery and specifically address continuous representation limitations such as high-frequency loss.
notes: Continuity is from INR; Fourier enhancement is auxiliary.

title: INF³: Implicit Neural Feature Fusion Function for Multispectral and Hyperspectral Image Fusion
continuity_variable: spatial query coordinates + local multimodal features
what_is_continuous: INF3 defines a coordinate-conditioned implicit feature fusion function that locally interpolates and combines HSI/MSI features to reconstruct HRHSI values.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The continuous implicit function is the fusion/reconstruction map itself and directly operates on remote-sensing spectral data.
notes: Strong INR fusion case.

title: Nonnegative Matrix Functional Factorization for Hyperspectral Unmixing With Nonuniform Spectral Sampling
what_is_continuous: NMFF replaces discrete endmember vectors with nonnegative functions represented by INRs so endmember spectra can be evaluated under nonuniform/incomplete spectral sampling.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The continuous object is explicitly the material endmember spectrum as a function of wavelength, which directly addresses a hyperspectral sensing problem with missing/nonuniform bands.
notes: Canonical wavelength-continuous CRS case.

title: Progressive High-Frequency Reconstruction for Pan-Sharpening with Implicit Neural Representation
what_is_continuous: Its SIIF represents and fuses multi-scale spatial and spectral features in a continuous domain to mitigate pixel-position misalignment.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The implicit image function is a core pansharpening fusion mechanism for satellite MS/PAN data rather than a generic high-frequency module.
notes: Continuity comes from SIIF; progressive high-frequency injection alone is not sufficient.

title: Spectral-Wise Implicit Neural Representation for Hyperspectral Image Reconstruction
continuity_variable: spectral coordinate / number of wavelength bands
what_is_continuous: SINR treats spectral information as continuous and performs continuous spectral amplification, allowing customizable spectral magnification and an unrestricted requested number of output bands.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The continuous variable is directly the hyperspectral spectral axis, and the method reconstructs the sensed 3-D spatial-spectral signal from CASSI measurements.
notes: Canonical wavelength/spectral-continuity case.

title: An adaptive multi-perceptual implicit sampling for hyperspectral and multispectral remote sensing image fusion
venue: Int. J. Applied Earth Observation and Geoinformation
what_is_continuous: AMGSGAN reconstructs unsampled HRHSI locations through adaptive implicit interpolation using multiscale neighboring features rather than fixed discrete interpolation.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The coordinate-conditioned implicit sampling is the defining HSI/MSI fusion mechanism and supports multiple reconstruction scales.
notes: Continuous spatial sampling; spectral information guides the interpolation.

title: Implicit Neural Representation Learning for Hyperspectral Image Super-Resolution
what_is_continuous: The HSI is explicitly represented as a continuous function mapping a spatial coordinate to its corresponding spectral radiance values.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: This continuous coordinate-to-spectrum function is the remote-sensing image representation being reconstructed and used for HSI super-resolution.
notes: Canonical HSI INR paper.

title: QIS-GAN: A Lightweight Adversarial Network With Quadtree Implicit Sampling for Multispectral and Hyperspectral Image Fusion
what_is_continuous: QIS-GAN uses coordinate-driven quadtree implicit sampling to reconstruct HRHSI spatial positions from low-resolution HSI features with MSI guidance.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The implicit coordinate sampler is a central lightweight fusion component for HSI/MSI remote sensing and replaces purely discrete fixed interpolation.
notes: Continuous spatial sampling rather than continuous wavelength.

title: SS-INR: Spatial-Spectral Implicit Neural Representation Network for Hyperspectral and Multispectral Image Fusion
continuity_variable: spatial coordinates + spatial-spectral latent features -> HRHSI spectrum
what_is_continuous: SS-INR learns an implicit coordinate-conditioned representation of spatial-spectral information to reconstruct high-resolution hyperspectral values rather than only a fixed feed-forward LR-to-HR mapping.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The implicit function is the central solution-space constraint for remote-sensing HSI/MSI fusion and directly addresses the ill-posed continuous reconstruction mapping.
notes: Strong INR fusion case.

title: Neural Operator-Based Continuous Tensor Representation for Thick Cloud Removal in Multiresolution Remote Sensing Images
continuity_variable: continuous spatial-spectral-temporal tensor coordinates across resolutions
what_is_continuous: The multitemporal multispectral observations are modeled through a continuous tensor/function representation whose intrinsic spatial-spectral-temporal structure can be queried/reconstructed across heterogeneous spatial resolutions.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The continuous tensor representation is the central mechanism for fusing multiresolution remote-sensing observations and recovering cloud-contaminated pixels; it is not simply a neural operator used on one fixed grid.
notes: Strong multiresolution continuous-tensor case; later full-text audit can record the exact coordinate parameterization.

title: Satellite Video Continuous Space-Time Super-Resolution via Mask-Based Temporal-Aware Warping and Cross-Level Frequency Integration
continuity_variable: continuous spatial scale + temporal frame position
what_is_continuous: The method targets jointly continuous spatial magnification and temporal reconstruction rather than only fixed integer spatial scales or pre-defined frame rates, with temporal-aware warping used to preserve inter-frame continuity.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: Both space and time are reconstruction axes of satellite video, and the proposed architecture is explicitly designed around continuous space-time SR rather than ordinary fixed-scale VSR.
notes: Classify as continuous space-time reconstruction; do not overstate it as a general coordinate neural field unless full text shows that formulation.

title: Seamless Daily XCO2 Mapping Across China with Transformer and Geo Implicit Neural Representation
what_is_continuous: Geo-INR encodes the geographic/spatiotemporal coordinate of each query and reconstructs a seamless daily XCO2 field from sparse satellite observations.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The continuous coordinate-to-XCO2 field is itself the Earth-observation product, filling gaps between irregular satellite samples in space and time.
notes: Canonical continuous geophysical/EO mapping case.

title: TAIS-Net: Time adaptive implicit sampling diffusion model for arbitrary-scale UAV video super-resolution
continuity_variable: spatial query scale/coordinates conditioned by temporal video information
what_is_continuous: An implicit decoder reconstructs UAV video frames at arbitrary spatial scales while time-adaptive features exploit neighboring frames; the output scale is not restricted to a small discrete set.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The implicit continuous-scale decoder is a core reconstruction mechanism for UAV remote-sensing video rather than an ordinary fixed-grid diffusion SR model.
notes: Continuity is strongest on the spatial scale/query axis; temporal modeling is adaptive but should not be claimed continuous unless explicitly parameterized.

title: A Unified Sentinel-2 Imagery Thick Cloud Removal and Rescaling Framework From a Continuous Perspective
continuity_variable: 2-D spatial coordinates/resolution -> material abundance maps; time remains discretely indexed
representation_family: INR continuous abundance maps + discrete spectral signatures
what_is_continuous: The framework uses INR to continuously represent abundance maps at different Sentinel-2 spatial resolutions, while spectral signatures at acquisition times are modeled discretely.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: It directly fuses multitemporal, full-spectrum Sentinel-2 observations of different resolutions and makes the continuous spatial abundance representation the mechanism that unifies cloud removal and rescaling.
notes: Important nuance: spatial abundance is continuous; spectral signatures/time nodes are explicitly discrete.

title: Hazy Low-Quality Satellite Video Restoration Via Learning Optimal Joint Degradation Patterns and Continuous-Scale Super-Resolution Reconstruction
what_is_continuous: The restoration pipeline includes a continuous-scale SR reconstruction module that conditions reconstruction on arbitrary target magnification rather than fixed integer scales.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: Continuous scale is a core part of the satellite-video restoration problem and reconstruction head, coupled to the learned degradation model.
notes: Continuous-scale reconstruction, not a continuous temporal field.

title: Streamlined Multilayer Perceptron for Contaminated Time Series Reconstruction: A Case Study in Coastal Zones of Southern China
what_is_continuous: After separating long-term components, the reconstruction network takes time coordinates as inputs and learns continuous functions for contaminated Landsat time-series signals.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The continuous temporal functions directly reconstruct missing/contaminated Earth-observation measurements at time locations rather than only forecasting a fixed-length vector.
notes: Strong temporal-coordinate case; spatial domain is not the primary continuous variable.

title: Deformable Convolution Alignment and Dynamic Scale-Aware Network for Continuous-Scale Satellite Video Super-Resolution
what_is_continuous: A single model reconstructs satellite video at arbitrary integer and non-integer spatial scales, using a dynamic scale-aware reconstruction mechanism instead of separate fixed-scale heads.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: Continuous spatial scale is an explicit satellite-video task variable and a defining capability of the proposed network.
notes: Continuous-scale only; motion alignment itself is not evidence of continuous time.

title: Depth and Geometry Regularization for Neural Implicit Reconstruction From Few-View Satellite Images
what_is_continuous: The satellite scene surface is represented by a continuous implicit geometry function, regularized by depth and multiview geometry, with radiance rendered from the recovered field.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The implicit surface is the recovered 3-D Earth-observation geometry from few satellite views, so continuity is the scene representation itself rather than merely the renderer.
notes: Strong satellite implicit-surface case.

title: Accurate and complete neural implicit surface reconstruction in street scenes using images and LiDAR point clouds
what_is_continuous: A coordinate-based implicit surface continuously represents street-scene geometry, with LiDAR and imagery jointly constraining signed-distance and surface normals.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The continuous surface is the photogrammetric/geospatial reconstruction target and is directly estimated from mobile mapping sensors.
notes: Canonical sensor-fused implicit-surface reconstruction.

title: Cross-sensor adaptive semantic segmentation for mobile laser scanning point clouds based on continuous potential scene surface reconstruction
what_is_continuous: The method reconstructs a canonical continuous potential scene surface from discrete mobile-laser-scanning point clouds using an implicit distance-field representation.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The continuous surface acts as the geometry-aligned latent domain used to bridge different LiDAR sensor sampling patterns for geospatial semantic segmentation.
notes: Strong example where continuity is used for cross-sensor invariance, not just 3-D rendering.

title: NeRF-LAI: A Hybrid Method Combining Neural Radiance Field and Gap-Fraction Theory for Deriving Effective Leaf Area Index of Corn and Soybean Using Multi-Angle UAV Images
continuity_variable: 3-D position + viewing direction -> vegetation radiance/density field
what_is_continuous: NeRF learns a continuous 3-D crop radiance/density field from multi-angle UAV imagery, from which view-dependent gap fractions and effective LAI are derived.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The continuous field is a physical vegetation scene reconstructed from remote sensing and is directly coupled to LAI retrieval, not used only for photorealistic rendering.
notes: Strong physical remote-sensing use of a radiance field.

title: RDS-NeRF: Residual and Depth Supervision Neural Radiance Field for Multiscene 3-D Reconstruction of Satellite Images
what_is_continuous: A neural radiance field continuously represents satellite-scene geometry and appearance, with residual/depth supervision introduced to improve multiscene 3-D reconstruction.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The field is directly reconstructed from satellite imagery and used to recover 3-D geometry/DSM-like structure, so NeRF is the scene model rather than a secondary visualization tool.
notes: Satellite-specific continuous scene field.

title: FVMD-ISRe: 3-D Reconstruction From Few-View Multidate Satellite Images Based on the Implicit Surface Representation of Neural Radiance Fields
what_is_continuous: The method represents satellite-scene geometry with a continuous neural implicit surface within a NeRF rendering framework and constrains it using few-view multidate observations.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The implicit surface is the 3-D reconstruction target from satellite remote sensing, explicitly introduced to overcome dense-matching limitations.
notes: Strong implicit-surface rather than generic NeRF case.

title: LiDeNeRF: Neural Radiance Field Reconstruction with Depth Prior Provided by LiDAR Point Cloud
what_is_continuous: NeRF continuously represents scene density/radiance while dense depth priors propagated from LiDAR constrain the geometry of that field.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The radiance field is the photogrammetric 3-D scene reconstructed from imagery and LiDAR, with geometric accuracy explicitly treated as a remote-sensing requirement.
notes: Retain because the continuous NeRF scene is directly the sensor-fusion reconstruction object.

title: PriNeRF: Prior Constrained Neural Radiance Field for Robust Novel View Synthesis of Urban Scenes with Fewer Views
what_is_continuous: The urban scene is represented by a continuous neural radiance field while multiview scene priors and camera-geometry constraints regularize its reconstruction from sparse views.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: It is a photogrammetric/geospatial urban-scene reconstruction problem in an ISPRS setting; the NeRF itself is the scene representation optimized jointly with camera geometry.
notes: Borderline with general computer vision, but passes because the continuous scene reconstruction and photogrammetric camera geometry are central.

title: rpcPRF: Generalizable MPI Neural Radiance Field for Satellite Camera With Single and Sparse Views
continuity_variable: continuous altitude coordinate + satellite RPC geometry
what_is_continuous: rpcPRF explicitly combines an MPI implicit representation with the satellite RPC camera model to capture a continuous altitude space while learning 3-D structure from sparse satellite views.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The continuous altitude/radiance representation is tailored to satellite imaging geometry and used for both novel-view synthesis and 3-D reconstruction.
notes: Very strong satellite-specific continuous-altitude evidence.

title: SatensoRF: Fast Satellite Tensorial Radiance Field for Multidate Satellite Imagery of Large Size
what_is_continuous: SatensoRF factorizes the satellite scene into continuous tensorial fields for volume density, reflectance, ambient color and ambient adjustment, queried along satellite camera rays.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The represented object is the multidate satellite scene itself, and the tensorial radiance fields are optimized to recover both imagery and altitude/geometry at large scale.
notes: Strong tensorial radiance-field case.

title: UAV-ENeRF: Text-Driven UAV Scene Editing With Neural Radiance Fields
continuity_variable: 3-D position + viewing direction -> UAV scene radiance/density
what_is_continuous: A dual-branch compact NeRF continuously represents a large UAV scene and is optimized so edited 2-D views remain consistent in the underlying 3-D field.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The NeRF is the 3-D UAV remote-sensing scene representation used for reconstruction, novel-view generation and controlled environmental editing.
notes: Retain as UAV continuous scene representation; text editing is auxiliary.

title: GAIR: Location-Aware Self-Supervised Contrastive Pre-Training with Geo-Aligned Implicit Representations
continuity_variable: geographic/spatial coordinates -> continuous latent feature field
what_is_continuous: The INR module reconstructs a continuous representation of remote-sensing imagery/features at arbitrary spatial positions and aligns satellite/street-view observations in a shared geographic domain.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The continuous geospatial feature field is the mechanism that makes cross-view self-supervised pretraining location-aware; it is not merely positional encoding attached to a discrete backbone.
notes: Strong continuous latent/geospatial field case.

title: NeRI: Implicit Neural Representation for Infrared Small Target Detection
continuity_variable: 2-D spatial coordinates -> high-frequency target structural features
what_is_continuous: NeRI explicitly learns continuous mappings from spatial coordinates to high-frequency structural representations of infrared targets, using INR blocks at multiple encoder levels.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: The coordinate-defined continuous feature representation is introduced specifically to overcome information loss caused by discretely sampled feature spaces in infrared remote-sensing target detection.
notes: Passes despite being detection rather than reconstruction because the continuous coordinate-to-feature map is a core mechanism.

title: Performance and Efficiency of Climate In Situ Data Reconstruction: Why Optimized IDW Outperforms Kriging and Implicit Neural Representation
continuity_variable: 2-D station location -> climate variable (for the compared INR), but experiments are in-situ station reconstruction
what_is_continuous: The compared MMGN model is a coordinate-based INR for sparse spatial climate-station reconstruction, but the study itself evaluates in-situ ECA&D station observations rather than a remote-sensing/EO sensing product.
why_continuous_remote_sensing: It is valuable negative evidence about when INR may not outperform classical interpolation, but it fails the repository's own direct remote-sensing/geophysical-sensing Gate A and therefore should not count as a core Continuous Remote Sensing paper.
notes: Preserve as context/counter-evidence outside the counted core bibliography; do not use it to inflate the CRS paper count.
